fields.Name: T183 - API Usage Time-Range Filter
fields.Description: Exercises the usage-analytics time-bucketing filter (setTimeRange + TimeBuckets/KPI recompute) — a distinct analytics code path with no generic-grid equivalent.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'API Keys' sub-section, then click the 'Usage' tab in the L2 tab nav. The API Usage Analytics panel shows a KPI grid (Total Requests, Success Rate, Errors, Avg Response Time, etc.), a Request Volume chart, and time-range buttons (24 Hours / 7 Days / 30 Days / All Time). Click a different time-range button such as '7 Days' then 'All Time' and verify the active button highlights and the analytics respond (chart/KPIs update or a valid 'No usage data' empty state appears). Success is the time-range control responding. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Usage' tab renders the usage analytics with a KPI grid and time-range buttons (24 Hours / 7 Days / 30 Days / All Time)
Selecting a different time range highlights that button as active and the analytics/chart update, OR a valid 'No usage data' empty state is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
